what_the_class_is: The 3D Auto as a whole: one source placed by the azimuth byte's 31 positions, a spherical head's delay, shadow and level per ear, a speaker rendering the Out byte switches in, and the level multiplier. Turn On runs the placement round once per cycle of the Speed byte's printed rate from where the azimuth puts it, in the direction the Clockwise byte gives; Turn Off holds it at the azimuth.

era.when: Mid nineteen-nineties, a custom fixed-point DSP running its effects at 32 kHz with a small control processor beside it.
what_that_implies: A placement a part of this period could afford is a few taps and a few one-pole filters per ear, not a measured head response per position: the per-position work is a handful of coefficients the control processor looks up.

A spherical head is the cheapest model with both cues in it -- a delay and a shelf per ear whose values follow the angle to that ear -- and it is front-back symmetric unless something is added to break that.

A loudspeaker rendering of a binaural placement cancels each speaker's path to the far ear with a filtered, delayed, inverted copy of the other channel; written on the sum and difference it is a filter on the difference alone and the sum is left, written on the two channels it is two cross-fed paths.
era.would_be_wrong_if: Takes of a placement off the median plane, read against their own input, showed the two ears differing by a response no delay and one-pole shelf can shape, or the speaker rendering disagreeing with the phones one on the median plane.

candidates.reading: A spherical head alone: per ear a delay and a head-shadow shelf following the angle to that ear, and a level that rises towards the near ear and falls towards the far one. Speaker cancels crosstalk on the difference between the ears only, so the median plane is the phones rendering exactly.
candidates.predicts: Behind rendering as the front (largest band 0.0 dB apart); the speaker front 0.0 dB from the phones front at its largest band.

takes.how: Third-octave energies of the held part of every take, averaged over the takes of one position, read against the same bands of the bypassed pair summed; a band is used where that sum is within 30 dB of its loudest band.

why_one_source.read_as: The inputs arrive 9.8 dB apart and the front placement returns them level and flat against their sum, so what is placed is the sum.

what_the_fitting_takes_said.which_type_the_takes_are_of: 01 71's sweeps. The Out claim reads this type, once its placement has arrived, returning the same thirty-one placements in both renderings, so the same laws are drawn here.
what_the_fitting_takes_said.where_a_fit_stopped: Without a rear cue the shadow's corner sits on the 300 Hz end of its search. The corner also sets the head's radius and so the interaural delay, which no magnitude constrains: that candidate's far ear lags by up to 2.73 ms.
what_the_fitting_takes_said.why_not_ranked_here: Every candidate is fitted to the same takes, and those directories carry no input the stage can find, so it never compares them. The stage compares the parameter walk's takes, where the type powers up turning, and the parked walk's with Turn off at the front: a rear cue shows as the placement comes round behind, a canceller that moves the mid shows at the front in the parked walk.

what_no_candidate_here_predicts: A narrow rise near 8 kHz in the near ear that reaches 13 dB at a quarter turn: no one-pole shelf draws it, so every candidate misses it by about that much there.
How the placement moves from one written azimuth to the next. The azimuth claim's own runs waited ten seconds and more for it to arrive; every candidate is there at once.
Whether the turning placement steps through the 31 positions or moves between them: every candidate moves continuously.
Which way `+` turns. Every candidate turns towards the positions the page prints as R, which is a reading of the page's sign and not a measurement.
Whether one cycle of the Speed entry is one turn: the rate claim reads the table, not what the modulator does with it.

Which filters the speaker rendering is in phase. The fit is to magnitudes a band at a time, which cannot tell a subtraction across from another pair of filters with the same magnitudes; the Out claim names the reading of phase between the channels as what would sharpen it.
Anything at the addresses the page does not print for this type, which the parameter walk also swept: no node reads them, so every candidate renders them as the power-on state.
